heroSummary: The Creality K1 Max is an optimal match for eSUN PLA+, reaching reliable printing speeds of up to 262 mm/s based on an effective volumetric flow rate of 22 mm³/s. However, because PLA softens at low temperatures, the top glass lid should be removed or vented during long prints to prevent extruder heat creep.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Smooth or Textured PEI Plate cleaned with dish soap and warm water (no adhesive required)
slicerTweaks: Set Maximum Volumetric Speed to 22 mm³/s in the Filament Settings to cap sustained flow and avoid high-speed under-extrusion.
Enable Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan at 60-80% to maintain crisp overhangs and bridging at speeds above 200 mm/s.
Calibrate Pressure Advance to approximately 0.040-0.045 s in OrcaSlicer to prevent bulging corners during rapid acceleration.
Set Chamber Fan exhaust to 70% or unseat the top glass lid to keep internal chamber temperatures below 35°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clicking and mid-print under-extrusion (Heat Creep)
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Trapped chamber heat in the enclosed K1 Max softens eSUN PLA+ before the melt zone, causing premature bulging in the cold block.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Remove the top glass lid or print a vented riser, and ensure the chamber exhaust fan runs above 70%.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Stringing and rough corner seam zits
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excess nozzle temperature combined with uncalibrated direct-drive retraction and pressure advance dynamics.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Reduce nozzle temperature to 210°C, set retraction to 0.6 mm at 40 mm/s, and tune Pressure Advance in OrcaSlicer.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: First layer peeling or curling at sharp corners
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PEI surface contaminated with skin oils or print bed temperature set too high, exceeding the glass transition threshold.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Wash the build plate thoroughly with warm water and dawn dish soap, and set the bed temperature strictly to 60°C.

faq.question: Can I print eSUN PLA+ on the K1 Max with the top lid completely closed?
faq.answer: It is not recommended; enclosing PLA on the K1 Max often raises chamber temperatures past 38°C, leading to heat creep jams in the direct-drive extruder.

faq.question: What print temperature yields the best strength-to-speed balance for eSUN PLA+?
faq.answer: A nozzle temperature of 215°C with a 60°C bed temperature delivers ideal interlayer bonding while sustaining high volumetric flow up to 22 mm³/s.

faq.question: Does eSUN PLA+ require glue stick on the stock K1 Max PEI plate?
faq.answer: No, eSUN PLA+ adheres cleanly to clean PEI without adhesive; simply ensure the plate is degreased with isopropyl alcohol or warm dish soap.

faq.question: Why does my top surface look under-extruded at high print speeds?
faq.answer: The default speed profile may exceed the hotend melt rate; ensure the maximum volumetric speed in OrcaSlicer is strictly clamped to 22 mm³/s.
